name: cloudbase
description: Tencent CloudBase for Kimi Code / Kimi Work — databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL/NoSQL), cloud functions, cloud storage, CloudRun, auth, and hosting via cloudbase-mcp. Format pinned to Kimi Code 0.34.0 (2026-08-18); plugin system is Beta.
author: Tencent CloudBase

interface.shortDescription: Operate CloudBase databases, functions, storage, and CloudRun from Kimi
interface.longDescription:
Installs CloudBase MCP tools and a routing skill so Kimi Code / Kimi Work can query PostgreSQL, MySQL, and NoSQL, list and invoke cloud functions, manage cloud storage, and inspect CloudRun services.

CloudBase credentials come from `tcb login` (or CloudBase API Key), not from Kimi inject mappings. After install, run /reload or start a new session, then say: 登录云开发.

Manifest format: Kimi Code 0.34.0 kimi.plugin.json (Open Plugin Spec style). Official kimi-cli plugin.json tools[] live in the sibling plugin.json for the Python CLI Beta path.
